regions.name: 云梦山 花岗岩核
regions.why: The main ridge (主脉) of 云梦山 with 古剑门 on it: a granite batholith in the core of the fold belt — the hardest rock stands highest and breaks into joint-bounded sword-like spires (剑峰) and sheer walls: 黄山 / 华山 country for a sword sect. 飞练崖 and 迎仙松 are its cliff and its crag pine.

regions.name: 云梦山 西脉 火山岩
regions.why: 百巧院's 西脉: our lore's horseshoe of 蜂窝山 and two ridges open to the south (the novel encloses it on four sides; kept open for flight — the player comes in from the south and the north-facing camera looks into the bowl) → an old caldera breached to the south: carvable welded-tuff walls for the cave dwellings, hydrothermal ores and 地火 for an artifact-refining sect. A cinder-cone field on the rest; 天柱山 at the west end stands alone (the demo's monolith).

regions.name: 笋石林 · 灵眼 喀斯特
regions.why: A limestone belt between the granite core and the volcanic west: 笋石林's stone shoots are a 石林 (Shilin-type) pinnacle karst. 灵眼之树 stands in our lore's open cliff-ringed valley (kept over the novel's cavern: a beacon seen from the air) — a collapse basin in the limestone explains the ring of cliffs and the falls; the canon's stalactite cavern survives as a cave under the cliff.

regions.name: 云梦山 东脉 石英砂岩
regions.why: 落云宗's 东脉 (天泉/火云/白凤/幻石/锁烟/隐剑): thick horizontal quartz-sandstone beds cut by two joint sets — the 张家界 peak forest, pillars standing out of the cloud sea. 子母峰 (韩立's abode) is a mother-and-child pair of pillars; 听云亭 sits on a col of the plateau.

regions.name: 绿踪沼泽 地堑
regions.why: The swamp on the 古剑门–落云宗 border (canon, with miasma): a graben dropped between two faults, poorly drained, filled with lake and swamp mud. 地脉灵眼 sits on its eastern fault — spirit veins follow deep faults.

regions.name: 南山 喀斯特
regions.why: The range south of 韵州城: a limestone platform — 峰丛 cones on the uplands, 峰林 towers on the 韵州 plain at the water table (the Guilin–Yangshuo picture round a city).

regions.name: 封日城 花岗岩岬
regions.why: The 闵州 headland that 封日城 guards: a granite headland, sea cliffs and stacks (崂山-like).

regions.name: 东海岸 喀斯特
regions.why: Coastal limestone hills west of 水影宗: towers at sea level, the drowned ones become stacks (下龙湾-like).

regions.name: 水影宗 喀斯特湖
regions.why: 水影宗 by the sea: a karst lake ringed by towers (the demo's natKarst sect, kept).

regions.name: 倪航斋 黄土
regions.why: 倪航斋's 乾土功 country: loess tablelands (塬) and gullies draped over the eastern range (the demo's natLoess).

regions.name: 鸾鸣宗 丹霞盆地
regions.why: 鸾鸣宗 on the eastern plain: a red-bed basin with Danxia hills — 丹 'cinnabar', 霞 'rosy cloud': red walls for a phoenix (鸾) sect. Uplift edits raise the hills the operator steps into mesas.

regions.name: 七灵岛 火山岛弧
regions.why: 七灵岛 and 灵鳌/灵龟/灵凤: newly risen islands south of 大漩涡 → a young volcanic island group; 灵龟 a caldera ring.

folds.name: 云梦褶皱带
folds.note: ENE-striking fold belt (the demo's relief.trend = 15°): strike ridges, trellis drainage

faults.name: 绿踪西缘断层
faults.note: the graben is only as long as the swamp basin, so the ridge south of it — 落云宗's dragon vein — is not dropped

faults.name: 飞练断崖
faults.note: the south-facing scarp 飞练崖's falls drop from

volcanoes.name: 百巧院 古破火山口
volcanoes.note: breached to the south: the horseshoe of our lore (蜂窝山 + two ridges, 朝南敞开) — the flight comes in from the south

uplift.name: 云梦东脉 龙脉
uplift.note: 落云宗's dragon vein: from the 祖山 above 古剑门 down the 主脉, round the south of 绿踪沼泽 (the saddle at x 5000 is its 过峡) and up to the 东脉. Without it the solve's rivers cut the divide (fengshui.py: col −156 丈)

uplift.name: 鸾鸣丹霞丘 西
uplift.note: Danxia relief 100–300 m (r3 S3/S29) → 30–90 丈 real, ×2 for the walls of a phoenix sect

glacier.note: a Pleistocene snow line below today's (the demo's snowLine 820): cirques and short troughs on 云梦's top
